# WO-2026-08-11-B15-COCKPIT-UI-01 — Cockpit UI: four-tab nav, question board, exception-first views

## Acceptance criteria

AC1: Navigation is exactly four primary tabs — Shop, Questions, Basket, Rules — with Diagnostics/About/History reachable only via a settings/cog icon, never a competing tab.
AC2: The Shop screen's status text is derived from the one canonical state value (fetched from the parallel backend WP's `services/asdair/cockpit-api/**` interface) and from no other independently-computed source — no raw-count-derived status string anywhere on Shop, Questions, or Basket.
AC3: No shop identifier, raw catalogue count, match-method internal ("matched by approximate alias"-style text), port number, DB connectivity status, raw confidence decimal, or internal event/state name appears anywhere outside a Diagnostics-gated screen. Checkable by inspection of every primary-tab screen's rendered output.
AC4: Every write action in the UI (answering a question, free-text override, accept-suggestion, "Change" on a resolved line, "not this week") calls the backend command-surface endpoint(s) from the parallel WP — no client-side write to any data store.
AC5: The photograph is displayed auto-rotated, and any per-line evidence shown is the specific region crop for that line, not the full original photo dominating the screen by default.

## Required evidence

- Screenshots or a described visual walkthrough of all four tabs plus the Diagnostics cog, sufficient for Vera's subsequent visual/WCAG QA gate — do not claim Vera's sign-off yourself, that gate is hers.
- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh --surface services/cockpit/public` → report exit code AND coverage. Exit 2 is NOT SCANNED, never a pass.
- Confirmation, by direct citation of the exact fetch/call site, of every write action's route into the backend command-surface per AC4.

## Inputs supplied

- `Deliverables/2026-08-11-cockpit-and-vision-pipeline-design.md` — Part 2 (the full spec; Part 1 is unrelated, a parallel WP)
- `services/cockpit/README.md` — operational hazards, in particular the documented stale-restart behaviour before treating any local count-mismatch as a rendering defect
- The parallel backend WP's interface (`WO-2026-08-11-B15-COCKPIT-BE-01`, worktree `C:/Fusion247PKA-cockpit-be`) — coordinate with Larry if the interface it exposes doesn't cleanly support a screen this order describes; do not invent a client-side workaround

## Explicitly out of scope — report, never fix

- `services/cockpit/**` outside `public/**` — the parallel backend WP's surface (`C:/Fusion247PKA-cockpit-be`, branch `build-015/b15-25-cockpit-backend`). If the backend interface doesn't support something this order asks for, report it — do not reach outside your surface to fix it yourself.
- `services/asdair/pipeline/**` and `services/obsidiwikai/**` — unrelated, a different parallel WP's surface.
- The visual/WCAG QA gate itself — that is Vera's, after you.
- Any live gateway, live shop, browser, or basket-build action.

## Sequencing

1. Standard gate: read back (outcome, plan, what this order failed to settle, what looks wrong) and HOLD for Larry's explicit acceptance before writing any code.
2. On acceptance: implement against `services/cockpit/public/**` only, in your assigned worktree/branch.
3. Git authority for this order is LOCAL COMMITS ONLY to `build-015/b15-26-cockpit-ui` (see contract_conflicts) — do not push, do not open a PR. Larry integrates.
4. Report completion with the required evidence above; flag Vera as the next gate, not something you self-certify.
